name: Relationship wall: three cards
when: The voice links three characters, left to right: who is confirmed to be tied to whom, and what is only rumoured. It plays on the footage under it, heavily blurred, warmed and darkened (`ground`; validated on a sunset shot). It ends on a cut.
anchor: The left card lands on the first name (the scene's start), the middle card on the second name (`at2`), the right card on the third (`at3`).

vars.theme: clean or vice: the video's theme
vars.name1: left card's name, 16 characters at most
vars.photo1: left card's portrait in the project's assets/ (shown 4:5, framed on its upper third: the face goes there)
vars.name2: middle card's name, 16 characters at most
vars.name3: right card's name, 16 characters at most
vars.link1: the label above the left string (between cards 1 and 2), 14 characters at most (the validated "Crossed paths?" is the widest that clears the cards); empty = no label
vars.kind1: confirmed (solid string) or rumoured (dashed string); default confirmed
vars.link2: the label above the right string (between cards 2 and 3), 14 characters at most; empty = no label
vars.at2: seconds after the start: when the middle card lands (its name); its string follows 0.7-1.2 s later
vars.at3: seconds after the start: when the right card lands (its name); at least 1.4 s after at2
vars.out: seconds after the start: the scene's end (it ends on a cut, the push runs until then); at least 1.6 s after at3

changed: Each string draws in 15 frames instead of 16 and 20, ending on the same frames as validated (f42 and f98): each part lands in 0.5 s. The cards' names, photos, labels, link kinds and the second and third cards' times are values. Photos are framed at 50 % 30 % (the validated Real Dimez still used 30 % 30 % on a landscape crop).
